text:
Anna: Throwing up a quick thread for keyboard-first concerns on the Error Explorer drilldown. main goals: ensure exports & id actions work without a mouse, and reveal flows are discoverable.
Mike: Good call. We keep losing keyboard users in the action menus. do we have an existing a11y pattern for 'Reveal full id' in a list row?
Tina: We don't have a standard for that exact micro-interaction. two approaches: inline toggle button (single tab stop) or a focusable truncation that expands on Enter. inline toggle probably clearer for screen readers.
Luis: Inline toggle needs aria-expanded and visible focus ring. also the toggle label should read "Reveal correlation ID" not just "Expand".
Raj: Implementation note: expanding inline will increase DOM size; prefer virtualization-friendly solution: show truncated content with a hidden offscreen element that gets injected on demand. make sure to restore scroll.
Anna: ok. Accessibility checklist to add: 1) toggle is in tab order; 2) aria-expanded on toggle; 3) aria-live polite region for copy success; 4) keyboard shortcut to open actions (e.g., '.' on focused row).
Mike: Shortcut idea: use Space when a row is focused to open actions. but Space also activates buttons. maybe use 'a' for actions? open to alternatives.
Tina: Avoid single-letter shortcuts that conflict with browser/find. prefer prefixed combos (.) are used elsewhere. Could be ';' or '/' reserved. Also surface shortcut in the row via visually hidden text for SRs.
Luis: For copy-to-clipboard feedback: send a visually hidden toast with role=status and move focus back to the copy button after action. This keeps screen readers informed.
Raj: Exports: current CSV vs NDJSON vs ZIP debate. product asked for a human-readable JSON by default. backend provides .ndjson stream for large result sets. we can transform on client for small exports. plan: default small download -> pretty JSON, large -> .ndjson with notice.
Anna: UX: show a single menu item "Download snapshot" which on hover/aria-describedby shows format and size heuristic: "Small: JSON | Large: NDJSON (streamed)". plus keyboard users can press Enter to trigger and then choose format in a modal.
Mike: important: permalink + copy id behavior. Copy id currently copies truncated value when row is collapsed. we need copy to always copy full canonical id.
Tina: yes. copy button should target the full underlying value and SR announce: "Correlation ID copied to clipboard". add aria-atomic so announcement isn't split.
Luis: a11y nit: ensure color contrast on the collapsed id pill (currently 3.8:1). Need 4.5:1 for text. update token.
Anna: noted. I'll update tokens in the spec.
Raj: Performance: if many rows are expanded, KV cache for stack previews will blow memory. propose lazy-load frames only when expanded and cap concurrently expanded to N per viewport. we'll add a UX affordance that auto-collapses least-recently-used expanded rows when threshold reached.
Mike: How to communicate auto-collapse? tiny snackbar: "Collapsed older traces to save memory" with action "Restore". keyboard users must be able to dismiss/restore via keyboard.
Tina: snackbar must have role=alert and focusable restore button. also should not steal focus unexpectedly — just announce.
Anna: Copy tweaks: change inline action text to these exact strings: "Copy ID", "Reveal full ID", "Download snapshot (JSON)" and in menu fallback: "Download raw (NDJSON)".
Luis: Also include a tooltip accessible via focus: tooltip content should be exposed via aria-describedby on focusable elements.
Raj: ops-bot: can we get a staging build with expanded aria attributes and the download filename header? pinging infra.
ops-bot: deploy queued: frontend/pr-4091, backend/pr-2175. ETA staging in ~15m.
Mike: OK next steps: Tina to author keyboard interaction doc + SR text, Raj to implement lazy-load cap spike, Anna to update design tokens & copy. We'll reconvene Tuesday.
Anna: added tasks in the board and a short prototype with keyboard walkthroughs in Figma. thanks all!
